_readme: Adventurers' Guild (js/logic/guild.js, docs/GUILD.md). Parts: base (numbers, contracts, perks), text (contract flavor lines), scenes (party scenes), ranks (rank-up story beats).
levels: merit needed for each rank, in order (index = rank number). board: offers per week (size + perRank x rank), how many contracts can run at once (active + activePerRank x rank).

contracts.<id>: label, icon, rank (lowest guild rank that sees it), slots (party size, Sam included), work (progress needed), weeks (deadline, in weeks from taking it), energy (each lady's weekly cost), wear (each lady's weekly Health cost),

stats / tech (lady weights: her stats via statOf and skills, 0-100 scale), sam (Sam's stat weights), risk (weekly injury chance per member before power/safety), hurt [min,max] Health lost on an injury,

gold [min,max] = the base purse, perWeek [min,max] = day rate per member (ladies and Sam) for every week worked, both x cycleMul(gold.perCycle); paid on completion (a failed contract pays pay.failShare of the day rates only). merit, fame (adventurer/mercenary client draw), pop (popularity for each lady on completion), tags (which party scenes fit: camp, road, delve, fight, ball, bloom), item (samUps key Sam earns the first time; null for none), desc.

power: a member's weekly progress = (weighted stat average) x energy factor x fx 'guild' (traits) x perks; Sam's = weighted Sam stats x his focus effort. safety: injury chance x (1 - power/safety.div), x fx 'guildSafe'.

perks: Sam's guild perks (S.guildPerks, kept for good across cycles). need: {contract: id or [ids], sam: n} = Sam went on that many completed contracts of those kinds; or {rank: n}. fx is read by code (hasGuildPerk).

scenes: chance per contract per week that its party has a scene (at most scenes.maxPerWeek overall). trust/lewd gates: duo (Sam + her), trio (Sam + two), yuri (two ladies, bloom tag), pair (two ladies, no Sam).

outfit: the guild-only outfit (wardrobe.json → guild) the first clear of a contract puts in the house wardrobe. loot: chance on every completion that the client adds a shop outfit the house doesn't own yet.

fits: {traits, titles, sam (Sam's guild perks)} that suit the contract. bonus: each lady with a fitting trait or active title adds fitEach (and Sam with a fitting perk), up to fitMax; finishing early adds earlyPerWeek per spare week (up to earlyMax); overshooting the work adds overPer x the overshoot share (up to overMax). A total bonus of at least `excellent` is an excellent job: merit x excellentMerit.
Ladies' share of the pay (their day rates plus their share of purse and bonus) counts as their earnings (report, profit cut); Sam's share goes straight to the purse.

minPower: the stat threshold of a higher contract: a member whose power is under it only adds power x power.under x (power / minPower), so high contracts clear slowly without strong members. pay.rankRate: day rates x (1 + rankRate x guild rank). board.lowerRank: offers of contracts below Sam's rank are weighted x lowerRank per rank of difference (the board leans toward his own rank). pay.samShare: Sam's own day rate and purse share x this (0.5: a contract Sam works pays him half what a lady gets, so the Guild focus doesn't beat Office/Watch at home).

carry: in New Game+ the guild keeps Sam's rank and merit (fame x fameKeep; contracts, board and parties are cleared, and the rank's people are offered again as candidates). The first NG++ resets the guild once (S.guildReset).

caravan.label: Caravan Escort
caravan.desc: Ride with a merchant's wagons to the river towns and back. Bandits are rare, mud is not.

porter.label: Dungeon Porter
porter.desc: Carry a delving party's packs, lamps and loot through the upper halls of the Barrow. Heavy, dull, and well paid for both.

herbs.label: Fenwood Herb Run
herbs.desc: Gather moonmoss and lustbloom for the apothecaries. The bloom's pollen is the reason the pay is good and the gloves are thick.

arena.label: Arena Bout
arena.desc: A pairs bout in the Hollowmere pit. Blunted steel, a loud crowd, and a purse for whoever is still standing.

ball.label: Bodyguard at the Noble Ball
ball.desc: Guard a baron's daughter at her debut without looking like a guard. Courtesan manners count as much as a sword.

courier.label: Exchange Courier
courier.desc: Carry sealed contracts for the Merchants' Exchange to the coast and bring back signatures. Rivals pay well to lose them on the way.

hunt.label: Monster Hunt
hunt.desc: A pack of something with too many teeth is taking sheep in the hill farms. Track it, corner it, end it.

delve.label: Deep Delve
delve.desc: Map the drowned lower halls of the Barrow for the guild's surveyors. Weeks underground, and the maps are worth more than the gold.

wyvern.label: Wyvern Cull
wyvern.desc: A nesting pair on the Greyspine crags. The crown pays by the head, and the bards pay by the story.

roadwise.label: Road-Wise
roadwise.desc: Sam's Guild focus costs 10 less energy, and any party he leads makes 10% more progress.

pitfighter.label: Pit Fighter
pitfighter.desc: Stand watch gives 25% more security, and Sam's step-in rescues are more reliable.

slayer.label: Monster Slayer
slayer.desc: Injuries are 40% less likely on any contract Sam goes on.

silvertongue.label: Silver Tongue
silvertongue.desc: Floor focus earns 15% more, and noble clients come a little more often.

delver.label: Deep Delver
delver.desc: One more contract can run at once, and every contract pays 10% more gold.

captain.label: Party Captain
captain.desc: Ladies on contracts gain 50% more trust and stat practice from them.
